title: Protocol for double-crosslinking ChIP-seq to improve data quality and enhance detection of challenging chromatin targets
author: Bao, Cacioppo, et al.
materials: Qubit dsDNA high sensitivity assay kit

steps.title: Convert bigWig to BED
steps.instruction: Run the command `bigWigToBedGraph ./BW/sample.25nt.RPKM.bw ./Bed/sample.25nt.RPKM.bed` to convert the bigWig file to a BED‑graph file.

steps.title: Sort BED file
steps.instruction: Sort the BED file by chromosome and start coordinate with `sort -k1,1 -k2,2n ./Bed/sample.25nt.RPKM.bed > ./Bed/sample.25nt.RPKM.sorted.bed`.

steps.title: Create tiled gene annotation
steps.instruction: In R, set the working directory to `~/Working_directory`, load the libraries `rtracklayer`, `dplyr`, and `ggplot2`, disable scientific notation (`options(scipen = 999)`), read the hg38 GTF file, keep only entries where `type == "gene"`, select columns `seqnames, start, end, width, strand, gene_biotype, gene_name`, filter for `width > 60`, split by strand, and generate upstream/downstream 5 kb flanking regions for each strand as described; finally write each table to the corresponding BED files in `./Tiles/`.

substeps.instruction: setwd("~/Working_directory")
library(rtracklayer); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)
options(scipen = 999)
hg38.annotations %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(type == "gene") %>% select(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, gene_biotype, gene_name) %>% filter(width > 60) -> hg38.genes
hg38.genes %>% filter(strand == "+") -> hg38.genes.pos
hg38.genes %>% filter(strand == "-") -> hg38.genes.neg
hg38.genes.pos %>% mutate(start = start - 5000, end = start + 5000) %>% filter(start > 0) -> hg38.genes.pos.upstream.flank
hg38.genes.neg %>% mutate(start = end, end = start + 5000) -> hg38.genes.neg.upstream.flank
hg38.genes.pos %>% mutate(start = end, end = start + 5000) -> hg38.genes.pos.downstream.flank
hg38.genes.neg %>% mutate(start = start - 5000, end = start + 5000) %>% filter(start > 0) -> hg38.genes.neg.downstream.flank
write.table(hg38.genes.pos, "./Tiles/hg38.genes.pos.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(hg38.genes.neg, "./Tiles/hg38.genes.neg.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(hg38.genes.pos.upstream.flank, "./Tiles/hg38.genes.pos.upstream.flank.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(hg38.genes.neg.upstream.flank, "./Tiles/hg38.genes.neg.upstream.flank.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(hg38.genes.pos.downstream.flank, "./Tiles/hg38.genes.pos.downstream.flank.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(hg38.genes.neg.downstream.flank, "./Tiles/hg38.genes.neg.downstream.flank.bed", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

steps.title: Tile genes and flanking regions
steps.instruction: Create 60 tiles for each gene (adding 20 to column V4) and 20 tiles for each upstream flank (adding 80 to column V4), then combine all tiles into a sorted BED file `./Tiles/hg38.genes.and.flanks.sorted.bed`.

substeps.instruction: hg38.genes.pos %>% mutate(V4 = V4 + 20) -> hg38.genes.pos.60t
hg38.upstream.flank %>% mutate(V4 = V4 + 80) -> hg38.upstream.flank.20t
Combine the tiled gene and flank objects and write to `./Tiles/hg38.genes.and.flanks.sorted.bed` (sorting as needed).

steps.title: Map coverage and plot metagene
steps.instruction: In R, group the dxChIP‑seq coverage data by `bin`, compute mean coverage (`COV.mean`) and standard error (`SEM`), normalize each bin to the first bin (`COV.norm` and `SEM.norm`), plot the normalized coverage with ggplot2 using the specified axis breaks and labels, save the figure as `./Plots/sample.plot.pdf` (width = 4 in, height = 3.5 in), and close the graphics device; if the bigWig files were spike‑in normalized, skip the additional upstream‑intergenic normalization and plot `COV.mean` and `SEM` directly.

substeps.instruction: sample.coverage %>% group_by(bin) %>% summarise(COV.mean = mean(COV), SEM = sd(COV)/sqrt(n())) %>% mutate(COV.norm = COV.mean/first(COV.mean), SEM.norm = SEM/first(COV.mean)) -> plot.data
ggplot(plot.data, aes(x = bin, y = COV.norm)) +
geom_line(size = 1) +
geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = COV.norm - SEM.norm, ymax = COV.norm + SEM.norm), alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
ylab("Normalised coverage\n( signal / background )") +
theme_bw() +

theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", vjust = 4), plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
pdf("./Plots/sample.plot.pdf", width = 4, height = 3.5)
print(last_plot())
dev.off()
